title: Music Player
shortDescription: Music player grouped by artist or composer, with playlists and Android Auto.
fullDescription:
Music Player plays the music already stored on your phone. No accounts, no ads, no tracking: just your library.

Main features:
- Plays every audio format Android supports: MP3, AAC, M4A, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, MIDI and AMR.
- Previous, play, pause and next controls, with a draggable progress bar showing elapsed time next to the track length.
- Scans the device and groups songs by artist. For classical music you can group by composer instead.
- Your own playlists: create, rename and delete them, and add one song to several playlists at once.
- Delete songs from the device when you no longer want them.
- Shuffle, plus repeat the whole queue or a single song.
- Music keeps playing with the screen off, with controls in the notification.

Android Auto:
- The whole library is available in the car, organised into Artists, Playlists and Songs.
- Controlled with the steering wheel buttons and by voice.

Artist photos (optional):
- If you turn it on in Settings, the app looks up each artist's photo and a short biography on MusicBrainz and Wikipedia.
- It is off by default. When you turn it on, the only thing that leaves the device is the artist name: no song, file name or personal data.

Permissions it uses:
- Access to the device audio files: that is what the app plays and groups. Without it there is no library.
- Media playback foreground service and notifications: so the music keeps playing with the screen off and in the car, with the controls always at hand.
- Internet: only to check whether a newer version of the app is available and, if you turn it on, to look up artist photos.

Free software under the MIT license. All processing is local and your playlists stay on your device.
